title: The DSMP Theme
description: This is a resource pack that I made with remade death messages, splash texts, different names for certain items, a custom disc and some updated textures, such as buttons, hotbar + hud, and title screen!
body:
**THIS IS THE FIRST VERSION OF A PACK THAT WILL HAVE MORE UPDATES :D**

---

Hey! I'm Equinox, a small creator from Australia. For a while I've had a project I kept to myself. But I decided;
Why don't I just make a _USABLE VERSION_ of the pack?
For other people to use too!

So I did. And here's the first version, because;
- I need feedback from other people
- I can't hold it in anymore

This is a resource pack that I made with remade death messages, splash texts, different names for certain items, a custom disc and some updated textures, such as buttons, hotbar + HUD, and title screen!

This is only for Vanilla 1.21.5 as a resource pack, and I haven't checked for compatibility issues yet. It should be compatible with any other in-game texture changing resource packs as long as it's on top :D

Here's some examples of the pack.

![Example of the Title, Splash Text and menu WITHOUT the custom buttons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b99ab689c4938774783939786b09f83439d89867.png)![The custom buttons of course.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/abb93d256119f8c6b8db03148a198794c9be02cf.png)![The HUD and Hotbar (demonstrated in hypixel skyblock but this is an unfinished version as you can see from the armour slots :'>)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60074b4cc14b1fbbdaf1b6971111d1fb3b39e126.png)
